resume: 12-bit drum sampler after the SP-1200: 32 sounds, eight channels with their filters, pitch without interpolation for grit. You sample on the FM-1 over USB or in the browser editor.

commandes.role: Back to the previous pad bank (A and B). With FX held: REV THROW, reverb send full on while held.
Pad banks C and D. With FX held: ECHO THROW, echo send full on while held.
FILTER (DJ filter on the mix), CHORUS, DELAY, REVERB.
The knobs switch to the faders of channels 5 to 8, until pressed again.
Sampling on the machine (RATE, TIME, THRESH, MON); REC starts the take. Held + a pad: erases that pad's hits as the playhead passes.
WAVE, SOUND (TUNE, FINE, DECAY, LEVEL), TRUNC, OUT (channel, PAN, CUT, RESO), SENDS.
SETUP, CLICK (count-in), OUTPUT. Held + white keys 1 to 8: mute channels 1 to 8; 9 to 16: solo.
Gives the faders back to the knobs when a page had taken them.
Saves right away (otherwise it saves by itself when stopped). Held + a black key: stores the loop in that loop slot.
MULTI PITCH: the last sound across the 27 keys.
Short press: LOOP (length 1 to 32 bars or AUTO, QUANT, SWING), loop tools, SONG. Held: the 16 steps of the last pad on the white keys.
Records: when stopped, arms (PLAY counts in); during playback, overdub. A press under 2 s is a simple tap; held 2 s, erases the loop.
Pads 1 to 8 (bank A) and 9 to 16 (bank B), banks C and D with OCT+.
Loops 1 to 11: when stopped, immediately; during playback, at the end of the loop.

gestes: GLO held + white keys: mute (1 to 8) and solo (9 to 16).
SEQ held: the last pad's steps on the white keys.
EDIT + OCT-: undoes the last erase or copy (again: redoes).
a_savoir: Samples are kept in flash at the place sloopDX leaves free; the original SLOOP keeps its own there: back them up first.
MIDI notes 36 to 67 play the pads, Program Change 0 to 15 select the loop.
